primitives.name: Dead Ball Forward Point Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: The forward point of the ball in its position when declared dead shall be taken as the determining point in measuring.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: x_determining: scalar distance along pitch (meters), p: vector position of ball surface points (meters), n_hat: unit normal vector pointing downfield (dimensionless), S: game state variable.
primitives.assumptions: The ball occupies a compact, bounded subset of Euclidean space; the downfield direction is strictly orthogonal to the line of scrimmage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if the ball deforms non-rigidly post-declaration or if the referee rotates the ball, violating the fixed orientation assumption.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the projection of a high-dimensional state vector onto a 1D manifold representing field position, enforcing metric consistency across discrete play boundaries.
layer2.telemetry: Measured yardage variance between official tape and optical tracking systems.

primitives.name: Kick Topology Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: (No kick shall be regarded as having given the opponents such chance unless it shall have crossed the line of scrimmage or shall have been touched by an opponent.) SECTIoN 3.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: I_valid: binary indicator of valid kick (dimensionless), Theta: Heaviside step function, x_ball: longitudinal coordinate of ball (meters), x_LOS: line of scrimmage coordinate (meters), delta: Dirac delta for touch event.
primitives.assumptions: Ball trajectory is continuous; touch events are instantaneous interactions that alter momentum and possession probability distributions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails under quantum tunneling analogies or if the ball crosses the LOS exactly at t=infinity; requires strict temporal ordering of events.

layer2.mapping: Derives a kernel function for GSI probabilistic models, defining the boundary conditions under which the 'fair chance' latent variable becomes observable.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of kicks ruled invalid due to failure to cross LOS or receive opponent contact.

primitives.name: Loose Ball Kick Prohibition
primitives.verbatim_quote: A loose ball, in possession of neither side, may not be kicked or kicked at.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: v_kicker: velocity vector of kicking action (m/s), Pi_home, Pi_away: possession probability indicators for respective teams (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Possession is a mutually exclusive binary state; 'loose' implies a superposition of possession states with zero amplitude for either team.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if simultaneous possession is mathematically permitted, or if 'kicking at' introduces non-local interactions without physical contact.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a conservation law in GSE state machines, prohibiting specific state transitions (kick) when the system is in an unclaimed equilibrium.
layer2.telemetry: Penalty flags issued for illegal kicks on loose balls.
